venue.name: Private Residence
venue.address: Address will be provided to registered competitors.

items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.

items.information: ### There is no 3x3 at this competition and it is held on a *Thursday Evening* **[Click here for other upcoming Minnesota competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=minnesota&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)** | | | -------- | We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions. | | | -------- | The number of rounds and advancement conditions are subject to change based on the competitor count. A second round of 3BLD may be added, and competitors will know the week of the competition.
